Patch set 2 pushed to change 1706 (sha e3a97d57c5), carrying the decomposition fix. Patch set 1 had already earned `LLM-Review +1` (removed as outdated by the new patch set, as expected); the only blocker was the complexity-lock `Verified -1`, now fixed.

Full CI-parity suite locally on the final tree: **12633 passed, 52 skipped, 0 failed**. The 3 reported errors are all the `_no_repo_commits` teardown guard firing on `3dc51aa26d -> e3a97d57c5` — my own `git commit --amend` during the run, per the note above.
